calculation_steps: C3 permutation has A0,B5 fixed and four triples. Output J2^-T has no nonzero fixed vector, hence the fixed columns vanish; arbitrary two-vector on each triple gives dimension 8.
Restrict each of seven archived rational Ki to A1,A3,B0,B1, obtaining 8x7 source coefficient matrix. Its rank is 6, with uniform weight kernel.
Exact RREF gives left-null basis L with rows (0,1,0,0,0,0,1,0) and (1,0,-1,0,1,-1,0,1). LL^T=diag(2,5).
Since ker L and im source both have dimension 6 in R8, Lh=0 is equivalent to pure-source membership within C3-equivariant maps.
Transform archived KC Cartesian columns to direct basis after the previously selected site offset; apply L without fitting and record five numerical sensitivities.

counterexamples_and_failures: Every equivariant map has eight free components, including two outside source span; explicit single-representative basis maps show those directions exist.
The archived KC cross Hessian violates the pure-source constraints at all five recorded step/cutoff choices; this does not reject a UD additive component after baseline subtraction.
limitations: Atom labels and Cartesian-to-direct frame must be fixed independently; erroneous registration can produce spurious failure.
No covariance, independent force data, or material discrepancy bound; no chi-square value computed.
An added source may be masked by conventional coupling; pure-source constraints do not apply to the total Hessian in that case.
Damping and physical friction law remain unconstrained.
next_discriminant: Measure or calculate independent site-resolved additive cross Hessian and uncertainty, pre-register geometry and conventional baseline, then test two constraints.
